review_quotes.author: Gagan Grover
review_quotes.text:
Had family dinner here. Food is superbly delicious. Delivery is quick. Prices are reasonable.
Parking is available on the road.
Though toilet is not sparingly clean. Something that should be worked on to really make it a five star restaurant.
